About Me

Dallas’s Independent Companion

My name is Morgan and I am one of Dallas’s premier private entertainers. I am 100% independent, DDF, college-educated, and everything between us stays between us.

Hi everyone! My name is Morgan and I am one of Dallas’s premier private entertainers. I am a California native but have lived in Dallas long enough to be considered a Texan. I have been an escort off and on for many years and I feel that the services I offer are meaningful and important in people’s lives. We all need companionship and intimacy in our lives and I am happy to provide that. I am 100% independent, meaning everything that happens between us is only for us. No one else will ever have access to any information you provide.

I take great care of myself. I exercise and try to eat clean and healthy food (although I do love a good cheeseburger), and I am DDF (drug and disease free). I love the outdoors and truly enjoy hiking, camping, and fishing. I love all of the typical girl things like shopping and travel and spending time with friends. I love a good steak and nice wine. I don’t really follow sports, but I love going to sporting events (except baseball. I will not). It’s pretty much my philosophy that any activity is fun with the right company.

I am college-educated and fun to talk to. I can engage in any sort of conversation but I will always try to keep things light and positive. You can share as much or as little about yourself as you’d like. I try to match your energy in that regard. I don’t mind if you want to keep things mostly anonymous between us and on the other hand, I would count some of my clients among my best friends and we know pretty much everything about each other. It’s completely up to you how personal you want our relationship to be.

Most importantly, I am a highly sexual person and I love to please and to be pleased. I say a lot on here but I know what you are calling for and do it very well. Your satisfaction is guaranteed. I can show you much better than I can tell you.
